description: Get the SurfBooking forecast for a surf spot by name (e.g. 'Carcavelos', 'Ericeira', 'Matosinhos', 'Peniche'). Returns the current 0–10 surf score with label, the level-relevant wave height, period and wind, PLUS a multi-day outlook (the best daylight window per day for the next ~week) so you can answer 'which day this week should I book a lesson?'. The score is level-aware and scored per spot (proprietary). Read-only, SurfBooking zones only: Portugal (27 zones), South Africa (4 zones), Spain (2 zones), Italy (2 zones), times Europe/Lisbon. Books or charges nothing.

level.description: Optional — the surfer's level. Tailors BOTH the score and the multi-day outlook to that level.

spot.description: Surf spot or beach name, e.g. 'Carcavelos' or 'Ericeira'. Min 2 chars.

name: surf_forecast
title: Surf forecast
